method: initialize + tools/list (anonymous, no tool called; roadmap#992)

tools.description: Authenticate with the Vareto backend. Returns a session_id that must be passed to all subsequent tool calls. Use auth_token="oauth:google" or auth_token="oauth:microsoft" to trigger a browser-based login — a browser window will open for the user to sign in, and the session will be created automatically. Alternatively, pass a Firebase ID token directly.

auth_token.description: Use "oauth:google" or "oauth:microsoft" to log in via browser (recommended). Alternatively, pass a Firebase ID token directly.

tools.name: authenticate
